name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for a walk-in tub project?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a general contractor for a walk-in tub project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor for your walk-in tub installation, consider their experience with similar accessibility projects and their knowledge of local building codes in your area. Verify they are properly licensed, bonded, and insured. Look for transparent communication, detailed proposals, and a clear understanding of the project scope. Ask for references and review their portfolio to assess the quality of their work. A reputable contractor will provide a comprehensive service, handling permits, scheduling, and oversight, ensuring a smooth and compliant installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessibility projects, local code knowledge, proper licensing, transparent communication, and good references.
